s01.text: Everything so far has been about moving bytes. Now what can they do? They become pictures.

s02.text: Your screen is a window. And every window is just pixels - tiny squares of light the computer paints fresh, every frame.

s03.text: The GPU takes those instructions and turns them into geometry. Millions of triangles, rendered in real time.

s04.text: The CPU prepares the scene. The GPU executes it. Together they translate bytes into motion.

s05.text: Shaders run on the GPU. They decide color. Light. Texture. What the eye will see.

s06.text: The frame buffer fills. Vertices become pixels. Triangles become images.

s07.text: And the loop repeats - billions of times per second - turning code into motion.

s08.text: Every pixel on your screen is the result of instructions. Code became light.

s09.text: From bytes to pixels. That is the whole stack. One step out of five.

s10.text: Next: how we make it beautiful. Color, light, and the frame.
